description.value: Ian Tan Gallery is a long-established (1999) contemporary Canadian art gallery occupying a striking storefront on Vancouver's South Granville arts corridor, known for its floor-to-ceiling windows and soaring ceilings filled with rotating exhibitions of paintings, drawings, glass works, and sculpture. The gallery represents both emerging and established Canadian artists and admission is free. Services extend well beyond viewing — collectors can access art consulting, framing, installation, and worldwide shipping.
